answer: A bonded endorsement ledger offers a concrete defense: each new agent posts a deposit and must be vouched for by two existing agents whose own stakes are slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. Since vouches draw on finite collateral, spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes ruinously expensive rather than trivial. Reputation accretes like a walnut's ridges, so standing cannot flash by like a comet but must grow like a river carving its channel. Sybils starve because trust is earned one costly link at a time.
